Name: For The Love of Gordon
Author: eleseaHonu
Description:
[b][u][size=3]Overview[/size][/u][/b]

Gordon has finally arrived in Stardew Valley, in all his pixelated glory.

You can now select him to be your pet.  Simply choose which Vanilla Cat you want Gordon to replace in the config.



[b][u][size=3]Config:
[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]"ReplaceCat"[/b]:  Simply enter 1, 2, or 3 to select which Vanilla Cat will be replaced (Default Value = 1).
[/list]

[u][size=3][b]Installation:
[/b]
[/size][/u][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip For The Love of Gordon into your mods folder.
[/list]

[b][u][size=3]Special Thanks[/size][/u][/b]

Gordon is BlaDe's beloved stream mascot.  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bla_de]BlaDe[/url] works magic with RNG:  he caught The Legend on Day 3 of Spring (Year 1), married Haley before the first flower dance and killed a Mummy with Calico Jack, all with Gordon snoozing delightfully on his lap.
